headline: Vote on FY27 budget book and superintendent evaluation policy, first reading of building use policy, and executive session items.
summary: The meeting will cover a student discipline hearing about an alleged weapon and school safety plans in executive session. It will also cover votes on the FY27 budget book and the superintendent evaluation policy.
items: Executive session: hearing on student discipline matter involving alleged possession of a weapon on school grounds
Executive session: discussion of safety plans, security measures, and emergency response plans
Executive session: resolution of a personnel matter
Report out on any votes held in executive session
Opening ceremony: presentation from Calcutt school community
Vote on Superintendent Evaluation Policy, second reading
Discussion of forming subcommittees: Finance, Policy, Special Education
location: Calcutt Middle School, 112 Washington Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
